name: WAGASCI-BabyMIND
full_name: Water Grid And Scintillator detector with Baby Magnetized Iron Neutrino Detector
summary: WAGASCI-BabyMIND is a J-PARC near-site neutrino-interaction programme comparing water and hydrocarbon targets, with magnetized muon tracking supplied by Baby MIND.
physics_targets: Systematic constraints for T2K and Hyper-Kamiokande
detection_principle: Three-dimensional scintillator grids surround water volumes to reconstruct charged tracks, with hydrocarbon samples for target comparison. Side muon range detectors and the downstream magnetized iron detector measure exiting muons; curvature determines the muon charge.

status.label: Multiple stages
status.evidence: The retrieved first-run report establishes implemented operation in 2019-2020; it does not establish the exact 2026 beam-cycle status.
